### ① Derived judgments
- Accept set / public surface: unchanged. One governed rule-text file and one changeset; no `ui/**`, `packages/**`, schema, exports or `.d.ts`.
- "`UploadProvider` / `useUpload` (`@object-ui/fields`)" (guide L249): true, `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx:5485`; `@object-ui/fields` is published (no `private`).
- "`createObjectStackUploadAdapter` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`)" (L250-251): true, `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:8024`; `upload-adapter.ts:12-13,18` implements the `@object-ui/types` contract.
- "`UploadAdapter` / `UploadOptions` / `UploadResult` from `@object-ui/types`, re-exported by `fields`" (L251-252): true, `ui/packages/types/src/index.ts:498` and `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx:5486`.
- Decision-matrix row (L309): consistent with the bullet; `@object-ui/fields` is already a minimum dependency (L24, L37).
- `@object-ui/providers` is gone from `origin/main`; `git grep "@object-ui/providers" -- skills/` on the head is empty (the card's pin).
- Token ratchet ceiling for the file stays 2727 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1044`, untouched).

### ② Semver level
`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, correct for a docs-only correction of a governed guide. Changeset carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, matching the PR body; no `Skills-docs:` line owed. `Check Changeset`: success.

### ③ Boundary flags
- PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- Deviation (two troubleshooting tips deleted to pay the ratchet): accepted. The guide's reader is a third-party app consuming published packages (L1-3, L24-25, L33-37, L225). `### Turbo cache issues` and "Run `pnpm build` — downstream packages need built `dist/`" are ObjectUI-monorepo advice; those rules keep their home in `AGENTS.md:63-64,367` and `CONTRIBUTING.md:63,94-95`; no `skills/**` file points at the deleted text.
- `open_questions`: none. File surface matches the order exactly.
- Check-runs at head (read 2026-11-05T22:24Z): no red; 11 still in progress. All-green is the landing-time check.

### ④ Design judgment
`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`: the rewritten lines teach imports that resolve on `main`, each attributed to the package whose `exports` publishes it; "is ObjectStack's" leaves room for a third-party `UploadAdapter`. The card's scenario (agent loads the skill, installs live packages, no dead dependency) holds. The remaining "Module not found" bullets read coherently.
- must-fix: none.
- should-fix: none blocking. Optional later: L341 "Run `pnpm install` to ensure workspace links are resolved" is the same monorepo-flavoured class; a later token payment could rewrite it.
